descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Pine Lake is better with friends.

FISH TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Play joins an open lake or opens yours. A private lake gives you a 4-digit code for friends. Up to 8 anglers share the same lake, each free to travel between the five spots. You see every angler's rod bend, their line and bobber, their fish fighting and jumping, and the catch they hold up.

CHOOSE YOUR ANGLER
Twelve anglers to play as. Your best fish of the session rides over your head for everyone to see, and every landed fish is announced to the whole lake.

THE LAKE DERBY
The host starts ten minutes. Everyone's five heaviest kept fish make their bag, and the board ranks the lake at the end.

A REAL ROD AND REEL
Hold a 7 ft spinning rod in your right hand and reach for the reel handle with your left. Squeeze the grip and wind while the rod bends against the fish. Set your drag, keep the tension in the green and keep winding when it jumps.

13 FISH, TRUE TO LIFE
Perch, bluegill, crappie, largemouth and smallmouth bass, pike, walleye, rainbow and brook trout, salmon, catfish, carp and a giant lake sturgeon. Each one is weighed and measured when you land it. Keep it or let it go.

YOUR LAKE, YOUR WAY
Five fishing spots, 15 real skies, 9 water colours, autumn colours or first snow, six rod colours and music. Six lures unlock as your rank grows, plus a catch log and challenges.

Voice chat is optional and off by default. You can mute, block or report any player. Playing alone needs no internet.
